mcq.q: On Saturday, the Edbridge Orchestra will ___ a new work by local composer Nina Borstein.
mcq.why: 오케스트라가 하는 일은 연주(perform). 작품은 작곡가가 이미 만들었음

mcq.q: Online ordering is ___ on Naito Cafe's Web site.
mcq.why: available on + 웹사이트 = 이용 가능. capable은 of만 붙음
mcq.rule: 뒤에 on이 있으면 available의 근거. capable of + 명사/V-ing

mcq.q: Mr. Aponte's photograph of the autumn foliage will be featured on the front ___ of Outward Expansion Magazine.
mcq.why: front cover = 앞표지. coverage는 보도·보장 범위

mcq.q: ___ who is unable to attend the quarterly stakeholder meeting is welcome to appoint a representative.
mcq.why: who 뒤 동사가 is(단수). Those who는 복수 동사
mcq.rule: Anyone who + 단수동사 / Those who + 복수동사

mcq.q: Singer Maria Stanley ___ today that she is scheduling a world tour.
mcq.why: 주어 단수 + 조동사 없음 -> 동사에 s 또는 과거형. 뒤 is scheduling은 that절 안쪽
mcq.rule: 빈칸 앞 주어의 단수·복수와 조동사 유무 먼저

mcq.q: ___ 4,000 Urlvac trash removal systems are in use in the eastern region.
mcq.why: 숫자 앞 수식어는 almost. quite는 '꽤'이고 숫자 앞 불가

mcq.q: The conference schedule will be posted online ___ mailed to attendees.
mcq.why: in case는 뒤에 S+V 필요. posted와 mailed가 병렬이라 rather than
mcq.rule: 빈칸 뒤에 주어 없이 p.p.만 있으면 접속사(절) 불가

mcq.q: The ___ of electric buses to our current fleet has made commuting much more pleasant.
mcq.why: the addition of A to B. substitution은 of A for B

mcq.q: The Oak Hill Art Museum offers several ___ exhibits and a series of limited-time exhibits.
mcq.rule: 문장 안의 대조 단어(limited-time)를 먼저 찾는다

mcq.q: Customer loyalty programs are ___ for many retail businesses.
After extensively ___ our hiring policies, the consultant recommended a simpler process.
mcq.why: After는 전치사. 뒤에 V-ing, 목적어 our hiring policies가 이어짐

mcq.q: The company decided to proceed ___ with plans to expand into new sales territories.
Collaboration between multiple agencies is ___ challenging, but our project-based consulting can simplify the process for you.
mcq.why: 흔히 어렵다. well은 형용사 challenging을 수식하지 못함

mcq.q: The desserts we had at Giovanni's Bistro were not as delicious as ___ we enjoyed at Monteverdi's Taverna.
mcq.rule: 비교 대상 되받기: 단수 that / 복수 those

mcq.q: The company picnic at Floral Park will begin at noon on Saturday and end ___ 4:00 P.M.
mcq.rule: until은 계속되는 동작(open until)에만. end와 불가

mcq.q: Austina Gallery is located at the northern end of Arch Street, ___ the Verdigris Bistro.
Once considered a specialty product, shoes made from recycled materials are now ___ available.
mcq.why: widely available = 널리 구할 수 있는

mcq.q: Nonprofit groups ___ up to three applications for funding consideration during any given calendar year.
The ongoing shortage of hardwood has caused the price of certain furniture items to ___.
The customer ___ to buy an extended warranty, so it is not eligible for a free repair.
mcq.rule: reject는 to부정사를 목적어로 못 받음 (reject + 명사)

mcq.q: Although much of the material was technical in nature, the audience appeared to remain ___ throughout Ms. Sharma's presentation.
mcq.rule: remain·seem·become 뒤는 형용사. 청중이 몰입한 상태 = engaged

mcq.q: ___ fresh fruit and vegetables, vendors at the Wattville Farm Market also sell various handmade goods.
Last weekend, Terriville Community Center held a ___ game night for neighborhood children.
Many farmers markets operate on a seasonal ___, opening in spring and closing in late autumn.
Mr. Sato will call into the meeting ___ the hotel's wireless network.
mcq.why: 동사 이미 있음 + 접속사 없음 + 뒤에 목적어 -> -ing

mcq.q: Not only has Mr. Ogbu ___ worked on the project, but he has also trained Ms. Jeong to continue the work.

The presentation was ___ by a Q&A session
praised the team ___ completing the project
two managers, neither of ___ was available
decided ___ the changes would be implemented
You can use it ___ that you follow the rules
You can stay ___ long as you keep it clean
Only after the inspection ___ the equipment approved
a ___ between the invoice and the shipment
We are on ___ to send them Monday
